final: SELECT p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_aCL_IgG, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ANA, AVG(e.ANA) / (SELECT AVG(sex_avg_ANA) FROM (SELECT AVG(e2.ANA) AS sex_avg_ANA FROM Examination e2 JOIN Patient p2 ON p2.ID = e2.ID GROUP BY p2.SEX)) AS avg_ANA_relative_to_mean_sex_avg FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX
